title: Modern Music Loft; Sleeps 5; 1 Mile to Nash!
description:
Discover the ultimate Nashville experience at our modern downtown condo, perfectly situated just a short stroll from the city's hottest attractions! 
Set in Gulch View -- a prime location near downtown -- this urban escape is minutes from the city’s incredible music scene, fantastic dining, shopping, and nightlife hotspots. Luxe amenities include a beautifully landscaped courtyard and a seasonal pool in the heart of the building (open May-October, weather permitting).
